pending_recorder_open_close.scope: Paused quiet source; opener completion not delivered before shutdown. Does not claim a timed disk-operation cancellation or pending-finalizer race.

recording.replacement_policy: One writer retains accepted PCM across source replacement. Output pauses while the session is replaced; wall-time interruption is omitted, not padded or measured as continuous recording.

steady_source_delivery.scope: Five-second no-control quiet playback after 200 ms settling; separate from whole-run seek/priming counters.

timing_scope: Per-session stopped execution histograms and graph-clock observations; percentiles are not combined across sessions. Unsupported flag masks mean unavailable. No scheduler-lateness, physical latency, separate-device drift or sustained qualification.
